component.name: Ocy
component.summary: Calm break reminders for your eyes

description.p: Ocy is a free, open-source eye break reminder that helps with eye strain the gentle way. About every 25 minutes a small card shows one of twelve hand-drawn eye exercises for 15 seconds, and every hour it asks for a 5-minute screen break.

Between breaks Ocy stays in the tray. It counts active screen time rather than wall-clock time, counts time away, screen lock, or sleep as rest, waits for a natural pause in typing or mouse use before showing a break, and works completely offline with no account and no telemetry.
Available in 40 languages with Gentle, Balanced, and Focused presets, adjustable timings, optional strict mode, and light or dark themes.
Optional, anonymous usage stats and crash reports (each only with your yes) and more Linux groundwork.
